comments.author: @karacavalron
comments.text: Im genX (56). Many of us did prepare, so for the younger generations do not let videos like this discourage you. at 21 I started putting 10% of my salary into the market via index funds. It took decades for it to grow but it did. Meantime I bought a house, got married, had kids, lived life but I did it all on 90% of my pay. My pay increased over time, I made it to 6 figures but no matter what I kept living on 90%. Eventually I got to the point where I could invest more, but I stuck with the 10% and took all excess I could (less a 6 month emergency fund) and paid off my house (did it in year 24 of a 30 year mortgage). I know it is way more expensive now then in the 90's 00's, I get it. Live off the 90%, even if you are in debt put 10% into the market and in 30 years you will have a nest egg. Good luck.
